name: gitpic
description: Upload a local or clipboard image to a GitHub repo (image host) and return a Markdown link.

interface.shortDescription: Upload images to a GitHub image host and get a Markdown link.
interface.longDescription: gitpic uploads a local or clipboard image to a GitHub repository used as an image host and returns a Markdown link. Requires the gitpic CLI, authenticated with gitpic auth login.
defaultPrompt: Upload this screenshot and give me the Markdown link.
把这张图片上传图床并生成 Markdown 链接。
Host these two images and return both links.
